description: Fast, modern, mobile-first game marketplace selling PUBG Mobile UC + Prime subscriptions top-up shop for Madagascar.

styles.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
styles.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800

typography.instructions: Import Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css. Never use Inter for headings.

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-slate-200 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center shadow-[0_-4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]

layouts.spacing: Use generous padding. p-6 for main cards, gap-6 for major sections.

motion.page_transitions: framer-motion for page entrances (fade in, slight upward translate).
motion.micro_interactions: Scale button to 0.97 on active/tap. Hover states must change background or border color smoothly.
motion.cart_drawer: Slide in from right (desktop) or bottom (mobile) with backdrop blur overlay.

hero.description: Energetic, dark overlay with PUBG yellow highlights over a high-quality game action image. Features a trust strip below it (Admin Online badge, Instant Delivery, MVola/Orange Money accepted).

product_card.description: White background, rounded-2xl, subtle shadow. Big UC/Prime icon. Old price crossed out, new price prominent. Popular badge absolute positioned top-right if applicable.

bottom_nav.description: Mobile only glass bottom nav containing: Achat, Abonnement, Event, Commande. Lucide icons, text-xs labels. Active state gets primary color.

trust_strip.description: Horizontal scrolling or flex-wrap strip containing trust markers. Green dot for 'Admin Online', lightning bolt for 'Livraison Rapide'.

pdp.description: Sticky bottom Add to Cart bar on mobile. Clear breakdown of bonus UC. Visual guide on how to pay.

hero_background.description: Person playing PUBG Mobile action shot, use with dark overlay and yellow text.

events_promo.description: Mobile gaming action for promo banners.

app_interface_mock.description: Controller/App interface for admin or feature showcase.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React components using .js files (NOT .tsx).
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Implement Framer Motion for smooth tab switching (UC vs Prime) and cart drawer.
Use Shadcn UI where applicable (Tabs, Dialog, Select, Sonner for Toasts).
Ensure 'mobile-first' CSS rules. Mobile view should prioritize the glass bottom navigation, hide standard header links behind a hamburger, or optimize for thumb-zone.
Strictly follow the color palette: MVola (#00A651) and Orange Money (#FF7900) should be clearly distinguishable in checkout options.
Never center text globally. Use left alignment for readable content blocks.
For Admin dashboard, use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3' or similar for stats, dense Table component for orders.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where text sits on top of images; use a gradient overlay or backdrop-blur.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text over PUBG yellow has drop shadow or use dark text for contrast.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
NEVER center align the App container.
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-xl buttons with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Missing image categories must not use generic placeholders; use solid colorful blocks with icons if needed, but refer to provided image_urls first.
